about: Shared cases for 'are these two venue names the same place'. Two implementations must agree with every row: venueKey() in scripts/buildIssues.js and venueKey() in apps/editor-console/lib/replacement-rules.ts. Change the rule in both, and add the case here first.
rule: Same venue when the names are equal after trimming, lower-casing and collapsing runs of whitespace. A blank name never matches anything, including another blank.
